notes.title: New DX version to celebrate new game ChainStaff.
notes.notes:
I'm releasing the DX update for free to players who already own the game!
This is to celebrate the reveal of my next game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976260/ChainStaff/
https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2976260/header.jpg?t=1718126766https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2976260/header.jpg?t=1718126766
Please wishlist ChainStaff today! It's a big help to me, as it helps support me as I keep making new games. As a thank you--here's all the new DX changes for Weapon of Choice!


 Uprezzed graphics to 4K resolution!
 Improved performance to consistent 60fps!
 Gameplay improvements: Player jump is quicker, enemies have been rebalanced for more fair challenge!
 Improved readability for "Deathbrushing", UI, and cinema scenes.


Weapon of Choice is my oldest indie game, and when I ported it to Steam back in 2015, I added a lot of cool things back then: Like widescreen mode, hidden collectibles, and keyboard + mouse controls. All those improvements are still here, and the DX version is even more polished and with better gameplay balance. 

Thank you for playing Weapon of Choice DX and all my Mommy's Best Games!

-Nathan
Mommy's Best Games
